Do not import, read, or consult any other file in this repository beyond specification.yaml itself; if you need a defined term (e.g. 'EFD dbl-2007-bl'), treat the specification's own inline formulas as the complete definition and do not look it up externally. Deliver independence-report-v2.yaml stating exactly what you read, what algorithmic route you chose and why it differs structurally from a Jacobian-coordinate producer (so a later reviewer can see the routes are genuinely different, not a relabeled copy), and an explicit no-scientific-run attestation: no fixture, certificate, curve, or scalar input may be realized or evaluated by this task -- py_compile-level self-check only, exactly as TASK-20260907-ecd3a2 and TASK-20260912-f821b2 both did for the producer files. This authorship does not, by itself, satisfy specification.execution_gate item 3 -- a later, separately dispatched implementation-review task must compare the two independent routes for agreement on defined test cases and rule on independence and correctness before any measurement gate opens.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether a genuinely blind, spec-only re-derivation of the checker/predictor pair is structurally realizable at all, and whether its chosen algorithmic route (affine slope arithmetic) is independent enough in form from the producer's Jacobian/EFD route to be reviewable as a real second implementation rather than a relabeling.
